summary: Improve presentation structure, slide clarity and live delivery through focused practice. Explore the five-day advanced presentation skills course.
lede: Presenting complex workplace proposals persuasively means clarifying the decision and organizing evidence for the audience. For analysts, project leads and technical specialists, this course develops audience-purpose analysis, evidence sequencing and slide review, using established message structures, rehearsal and question-response planning to strengthen delivery.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course suits professionals who present recommendations, project updates, technical proposals or operational decisions and want a structured way to improve their message, slides and live delivery.
modules: Audience Analysis with the Rhetorical Triangle
Mayer's Multimedia Principles and Cognitive Load
Vocal Delivery and Nonverbal Presentation Cues
prerequisites: No coding or programming is required. You will benefit from bringing a current or planned work presentation topic for the practice exercises.
